crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false…
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…

translations.web: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
translations.bsb: But if you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.
translations.kjv: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
translations.asv: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
